security.csp: default-src 'self'; style-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline'; script-src 'self'; img-src 'self' data:; connect-src 'self' ipc: http://ipc.localhost

bundle.shortDescription: Your local knowledge base for AI agents, with a tray icon
bundle.longDescription: brain keeps your notes, profile and memory in one local place for Claude, ChatGPT and other agents. The app opens the brain dashboard in its own window and stays in the menu bar or tray. A click on the icon opens a notch with your graph; vault changes can show up there or as a system notification.
